messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Synthetic check alert — high failure rate for /v1/healthprobe across apac1, eu-west-1. Trigger=three consecutive 5xxs in 60s. @oncall paging via PagerDuty. Details: https://redwood-mon/synth/6298765432
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-83421 created and triggered to: Alice Park (oncall). Pager link: https://pd.inc/INC-83421
Alice Park: acked the PD incident, jumping in. seeing ~40% 5xx on apac1 probes in the last 5m, eu-west weaker spike (~12%).
Sam Lee: Grafana dashboards show timeline spike starting 6298765200. Request latency also up ~200ms for the same probe in apac1. No upstream deploys in the window.
Diego Ramos: checking prober fleet — apac1 runner-7 is reporting connection resets to backend pool B. Fetch logs now.
Maya Chen: any customer-facing errors? Jules?
Jules Ortega: Support telemetry: a handful of users on apac region hitting model generation errors, ~0.3% of total requests from customers in apac over last 10m. Not widespread but noisy for the affected prefix.
Alice Park: quick mitigation options: 1) disable apac1 prober batch and failover to apac2; 2) throttle synth frequency; 3) temporarily route requests to standby pool. Prefer option 1 to reduce noise while we investigate.
Diego Ramos: running command to cordon runner-7 and drain batch: ```infractl probe cordon runner-7 --region=apac1 && infractl probe drain runner-7 --timeout=60s```
Diego Ramos: cordon+drain issued, runners show draining. Also bumping prober concurrency down in apac1: ```k apply -f prober-config-apac1.yaml --patch '{"spec":{"concurrency":2}}'```
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-83421 acknowledged by Alice Park. Escalation paused.
incident-bot: Canary rechecks scheduled every 30s while incident open. Next checks due in ~20s.
Sam Lee: after cordon, apac1 probe failures dropped to ~5% in the next two checks. latency trending down.
Maya Chen: checking runtime pool B logs — seeing increased 502s from the autoscaler handshake with model-workers around 6298765100-6298765300. Might be transient networking between GPU nodes and runtime frontends.
Alice Park: good signal. I'll open a follow-on issue for infra networking, but keep this thread focused on on-call mitigation and customer impact.
Jules Ortega: updated customers via status page: short blip affecting a subset of apac users; no action required. Posted note: "Investigating increased error rates for apac requests — mitigation in progress."
Diego Ramos: started a targeted restart of frontend cluster bk-pool-B in apac1: ```k rollout restart deployment/frontends-bk-pool-B -n runtime-apac1``` — monitoring.
Sam Lee: rechecks show apac1 probe error ~1.2% now, eu-west stable at ~10->6% then back to baseline. Good improvement.
Maya Chen: restarted bk-pool-B replicas came up clean, kernel logs show transient network flaps from host nic-12. Raised host-level alert to eng-infra.
Alice Park: handing off to Diego for deeper infra follow-up. I'll mark PD incident as resolved once we confirm sustained recovery for 15m.
Diego Ramos: taking oncall follow-up. Will keep watch and create infra incident for NIC flaps.
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-83421 status: Monitor (acknowledged) — assigned to Alice Park, escalation stopped.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Synthetic checks recovered in apac1 and eu-west-1. Recovery time 6m.
Jules Ortega: status page updated: "Mitigation complete; degraded experience for a subset of apac users resolved. Root cause investigation ongoing."
Alice Park: resolving PD incident now. /pd resolve INC-83421
pagerduty-bot: INC-83421 resolved by Alice Park.
Maya Chen: creating post-incident ticket with notes: NIC flapping on host group -> frontend restarts -> probe failures. Will include timelines and logs.
Diego Ramos: I've recorded the mitigation commands and timeline in the incident doc. Will coordinate with eng-infra for hardware remediation.
Alice Park: thanks team. Quick retro tomorrow 10:30 to decide whether to add tighter probe backoff and per-runner circuit breaker. :thumbsup:
